brand.name: Lost Monster
brand.tagline: Built by someone who runs businesses, not just codes for them.
brand.description: Personal expertise brand — bold, dark, dramatic. Framework-driven development with 50+ projects, 70% cost savings, and 2-4 week delivery.

philosophy.headline: Bold Personal Brand
philosophy.description: Dark, dramatic, personal. Not corporate. Not safe. Not a template. This is a personal expertise brand that commands attention with massive typography, dynamic colour theming, and an honest first-person voice.
philosophy.credo: Systems over heroics. Business results over technical elegance. Honesty over optimism.

traits.name: Dark & Dramatic
traits.description: Dark gradient backgrounds create depth and focus. Never light, never corporate.

traits.name: Massive Typography
traits.description: Hero headlines at 128px. Section headings at 60px. Bold, not timid.

traits.name: Dynamic Colour
traits.description: 5 user-selectable accent colours. The site adapts to the visitor's preference.

traits.name: Personal Voice
traits.description: First-person 'I' voice throughout. Direct, honest, metrics-driven.

traits.name: Glassmorphism
traits.description: Translucent cards with backdrop blur on dark surfaces. Technical but premium.

colours.description: Dynamic 5-colour theming system. Accent colours are controlled via JavaScript state, not Tailwind classes. Backgrounds use gradient combinations per colour.
doRules: Use dynamic colour system — style={{ color: color.accent }}
Borders at 20% opacity — style={{ borderColor: color.accent + '20' }}
dontRules: Never hardcode accent colours — always read from state
Never use light page backgrounds on the homepage or hero sections
Never use bg-white as a full-page background (except content-heavy prose pages)

typography.description: Bold scale designed for maximum impact. Hero headlines reach 128px. Body text stays readable at 20-24px. Two font families: Outfit for headings, Inter for body.

heading.usage: All headings, hero text, section titles

body.usage: Body text, labels, descriptions, UI elements

doRules: Hero text must be text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-9xl — never smaller
Use font-heading for all headings, font-body for everything else
Responsive typography — always include mobile and desktop sizes
tracking-tighter on hero and section headings for impact
dontRules: Never use text-4xl or smaller for hero headlines — too timid
Never use font-body for headings or font-heading for body text
Never skip responsive sizing — text-6xl alone is wrong, needs md: and lg: variants

variants.name: Primary
variants.spec: Dynamic accent bg, white text, rounded-xl, px-8 py-4

variants.name: Secondary
variants.spec: Transparent bg, accent border, accent text

variants.name: Ghost
variants.spec: No bg, no border, accent text with hover underline

variants.name: Glass (dark bg)
variants.usage: Metric cards, feature cards on dark backgrounds

variants.name: Elevated (light bg)
variants.usage: Service cards, case study cards on light backgrounds

backgrounds.description: Dark gradient backgrounds are the foundation. The SVG grid pattern adds technical texture. Glassmorphism cards float on top.

gridPattern.description: SVG grid overlay at very low opacity for technical texture. Applied with fixed positioning and pointer-events-none.

rules: Always apply grid pattern on dark pages
Grid opacity 0.30 on the container (stroke itself is 0.02 opacity)
Always inherit text colour — never hardcode icon colours
Use dynamic accent colour for feature icons: style={{ color: color.accent }}
No emoji — ever. Lucide icons only.

hoverEffects.name: hover-glow
hoverEffects.spec: shadow-lg with primary-600/20 glow on hover

hoverEffects.name: btn-shine
hoverEffects.spec: Gradient sweep across button on hover

doRules: Use real photography — never stock photos
Full-bleed photography with subtle parallax where appropriate
Progressive image loading with blur-up placeholders
dontRules: No AI-generated images without clear context
priority: SVG grid patterns at very low opacity (technical feel)

persona.name: Graduate Grace
persona.role: Hospitality management grad, first full-time job
persona.trait: Not technical. Never read a tooltip. Calls everything 'the website'. If it's not obvious, she closes the tab.

voice.rule: If you have to explain what a button does, the button text is wrong.

traits.name: Personal
traits.description: 'I build' not 'we build'. 'I understand' not 'our team provides'.

traits.name: Direct
traits.description: Lead with the answer. Skip preamble. No filler words.

traits.name: Specific
traits.description: '2-4 weeks' not 'fast'. '70% savings' not 'affordable'. '50+ projects' not 'experienced'.

traits.name: Honest
traits.description: If I can't help, I say so. No overselling. No buzzwords.

antiPatterns.name: Light backgrounds on hero
antiPatterns.description: Homepage and hero sections must always be dark gradient. Never bg-white.

antiPatterns.name: Corporate 'we' voice
antiPatterns.description: This is a personal brand. Always 'I', never 'we' or 'our team'.

antiPatterns.name: Timid typography
antiPatterns.description: Hero headlines must be text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-9xl. Anything smaller is wrong.

antiPatterns.name: Hardcoded accent colours
antiPatterns.description: Accent colours must come from dynamic state, not Tailwind classes.

antiPatterns.name: Stock photography
antiPatterns.description: Every image must be real — project screenshots, code, or abstract patterns.

antiPatterns.name: Generic button labels
antiPatterns.description: 'Submit', 'Click here', 'Learn more' — these all fail the Grace test.

antiPatterns.name: Missing metrics
antiPatterns.description: Every key page must show: 50+ projects, 70% savings, 4.9/5 rating, 2-4 wks.

antiPatterns.name: Emoji usage
antiPatterns.description: No emoji anywhere. Lucide icons only.
